title: Operator step 0/6 conditions cleanup on `spec.traffic` showing `latestRevision: true`, then runs `update-traffic --to-latest`. The live service shows 100 percent on named revision vidysea-knowledgebase-00015-rbd plus a `latestRevision: True` entry that is only the `kb-login-test` tag. Following step 6 literally would send 100 percent of production traffic to the newest revision, which restores nothing; and `--no-traffic` will re-pin the kb-login-test tag to the previous latest revision (manifest step 5 only partly anticipates this).
fix_direction: Rewrite step 0 to record the full spec.traffic (percent+revisionName+tag per entry) and step 6 to restore exactly that recorded list (for example update-traffic --to-revisions=<recorded>=100 and re-assign kb-login-test), never --to-latest unless the recorded traffic had latestRevision with percent 100. Doc-only change to the manifest operator section.
